title: Kenyan Passion Fruit Cheesecake
community: Urban Kenya — Nairobi bakery and café culture
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Passion Fruit Cheesecake — a no-bake cream cheese cheesecake on a biscuit base, topped with a vivid, tart passion fruit curd that glistens beautifully. The definitive Nairobi bakery dessert — fresh, tropical, and completely irresistible.
longDesc: Passion fruit cheesecake has become the most iconic dessert in Nairobi's thriving bakery scene. The no-bake cream cheese filling is rich and smooth, the biscuit base is buttery and crunchy, and the passion fruit curd topping is brilliantly tart and fragrant. Together they create a dessert that showcases Kenya's most distinctive fruit at its finest.
ingredients: 2 tsp gelatin dissolved in 3 tbsp warm water — or 2 tsp agar agar
½ cup passion fruit pulp — from about 8 passion fruits
steps: Make base: mix crushed biscuits with melted butter. Press firmly into the tin base. Refrigerate 20 minutes.
Make passion fruit curd: whisk passion fruit, egg yolks, and sugar in a saucepan over low heat until thick — 8—10 minutes. Remove. Whisk in butter. Cool completely.
Make filling: beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Add vanilla and dissolved gelatin.
In a separate bowl, whip cream to soft peaks. Fold into cream cheese mixture.
Pour filling over biscuit base. Smooth the top.
Refrigerate for 4 hours until fully set.
Spread passion fruit curd over the set cheesecake.
Refrigerate 1 more hour. Unmould and serve.
chefTips: The gelatin or agar agar is essential for a no-bake cheesecake that holds its shape when sliced.
Cool the curd completely before spreading — warm curd melts the cream cheese layer.
The cheesecake can be made 2 days ahead — it improves overnight.
cookingScience: See KEN217 for passion fruit curd science. In the cheesecake, the gelatin creates a continuous protein-gel network throughout the cream cheese-cream mixture, allowing it to set firm enough to slice while remaining creamy — without baking.
sustainabilityTips: Kenya's passion fruit makes this the most locally relevant Nairobi dessert.
culturalNote: Passion fruit cheesecake is the dessert that has come to define Nairobi's modern bakery culture — a perfect marriage of international technique and Kenya's most distinctive tropical fruit.
